description: This file defines the data structures and functions for aggregating and analyzing the lifecycle status of workflows based on execution nodes and steps in a workflow management system.

classes.name: AggregatedWorkflowStatus
classes.description: A data structure capturing lifecycle details (status, counts, time metrics, etc.) of a workflow based on its execution nodes and steps.

methods.name: AggregateExecutions
methods.description: Inspects execution records and workflow steps to produce an overall status summary of the workflow.
